changelog: Post-play: at the credits the picture shrinks into the corner and the next episode, or the next film in its collection with its trailer, takes the screen. Skip Intro rises above the controls. Discover gets a header row with search and Requests, a feature that takes turns through what's trending, request states from the download stack (Awaiting Release, not Processing) and a 1080p / 4K choice when requesting. Card menus match across rows; the stray line under Up Next's menu button is gone.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
name: Hera TV
overview: The Apple TV app's look for Jellyfin's web client
